description: The technology directory: the apps and vendors detected on tracked brands' sites (Shopify, Klaviyo, Recharge…), ranked by how many brands use each and how those brands are doing. Pass `slug` for one technology's adopter stats and its category peers. To list the brands or ads behind a technology, pass its name as `technologies` to sightglass_find_ads or sightglass_find_site_pages. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again. Works without a Replo account: call it before asking the user to sign in.

category.description: App category as the fingerprinter labels it, e.g. email-sms

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

slug.description: One technology's slug from an earlier result: returns its adopter stats and peers instead of the directory.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_technologies
title: Find technologies
